N. 08(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of Section 13AA of the Representation of the People Act, 1950 (43 of 1950) and in supersession of its previous notification No. 508/GOA/2008 dated 11th June, 2008 regarding designation of District Election Officer, the Election Commission, in consultation with the State Government, hereby designates for each District in the State of Goa, as specified in column (1) of the Table below, the officer specified against it in column (2) thereof, as the District Election Officer for that District and specifies the area in respect of which each such officer shall exercise jurisdiction, in column (3) of the table :- TABLE Sl.
